data.name: TextBox3.Text
data.value: A repetition structure, or loop causes one or more statements to repeat Each repetition of the loop is called an iteration Visual Basic has three types of loops: Do While variable = value Do Until For… Next The difference among them is how they control the repetition

data.name: TextBox1.Text
data.value: The Do While loop has two important parts: a Boolean expression that is tested for a True or False value a statement or group of statements that is repeated as long as the Boolean expression is true, called Conditionally executed statements

data.name: TextBox2.Text
data.value: A nested loop is a loop inside another loop The hands of a clock make a good example The hour hand makes 1 revolution for every 60 revolutions of the minute hand The minute hand makes 1 revolution for every 60 revolutions of the second hand For every revolution of the hour hand the second hand makes 36,000 revolutions
